initialization: one unchanged parent followed by 15 independently randomized genomes; existing shared evolution operators
finalist: last generation training winner; no reselection or budget extension using evaluation
retention: all 12 material_arrival_mixed_train_v1 cases evaluated for every candidate
quality: final speed and frozen-marker distance: floor(1000 * clamp(1 - value/scale, 0, 1)), scales 70 and 100; only arrived, timeout or host_preempted approaches earn progress; completed handoffs dominate progress, old training arrivals dominate all approach terms
training_selection: first census free direct transfer within each of 65 and 35 units, per seed 42/10101 and seat, weak-angular only; identical source identities deduplicated
development: all eight frozen recovery_guidance_approach_probe_v1 cases; four overlap training and four are correlated dirt variants
validation_selection: first source per seed/shape/seat with free direct transfer, entry distance <=35, finite unsaturated features, and the common neutral handoff retaining these conditions; discover initial states only before training; no candidate/reference continuation consulted
missing_validation: retain as missing, never substitute another seed; acceptance requires all 16 starts
episode: same 300-step physical gates, native capture handoff and held-mission component experiment as recovery_guidance_approach_probe_v1
gate: all seven training approaches, all eight development approaches, all 16 validation approaches and every case in the original six mixed-arrival partitions must arrive; failures and missing cases remain failures
evaluation_timing: after the fixed training budget completes; no reserved continuation outcomes used in selection
scope: one continuation run; correlated match cases; component development evidence, no reliability estimate, production adapter or default change
